name: EPSM Pocket CAD
description: Modern readable surfaces with native pixel identity. Importing assets is an explicit application decision.

tokens.font-sans: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
tokens.font-mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', Inter, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace

notes: Apply a role first, then interaction state; retain the role dash pattern when selected.
Selected casing is a separate wider underlay; it is not a Leaflet PathOptions property.
Hover extraWeight adds to the current weight; it does not replace role properties.
Patterns require a renderer adapter; pair invalid geometry with a visible reason.
Store stable feature id, role, selected and validity independently of colour.
These are overlay presets, not a tile service, basemap licence or working map adapter.
